message.content: {"basis": "The independent visual notes confirm that gray shading denotes states with no data or not applicable, and that Texas (TX) is shaded pale yellow (high incidence), Washington (WA) is shaded dark burgundy (low incidence), and Colorado (CO) is shaded gray (missing data). Under the supported reading r2, gray states are excluded from the comparison. Therefore, Texas (TX) is the only candidate with displayed incidence among the options, and it is the highest. The task requires routing to the highest-incidence jurisdiction, so Texas (TX) is the correct choice.", "option_label": "Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing"}
